title: Export Transaction History Note
caption: Create a CSV export of your transaction history (old Eternl v1 format)

csv.headline: Export Transaction History
csv.caption: Export your transaction and rewards history (per account) as a CSV file.

csvExport.label: CSV Export
csvExport.caption: Set your export preset and enable or disable the export feature.

notes.label: Notes
notes.caption: Export transaction notes in the last column. The export will combine multi-line notes.

localTime.label: Export Local Timestamp
localTime.caption: Enable this if you want to export transaction times in your local timezone and format. Otherwise, they'll be exported as UTC time.
